title: manager setup · Advance to a planner for one bounded, research-only memory-systems aud
summary: Advance to a planner for one bounded, research-only memory-systems audit.
body:
Goal: Plan a single research loop that inspects up to four primary sources on practical agent-memory systems or methods, including approaches beyond skills and Markdown. Test superiority empirically against simple baselines; do not assume any approach wins.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define a bounded scope and an auditable stopping rule (for example, four eligible sources or exhaustion of a narrowly specified query set).
- Record every search query and its outcome.
- For each source, capture the canonical HTTPS URL, exact sections inspected, storage model, write/update policy, retrieval method, forgetting and contradiction handling, comparison baseline, budget comparability, and author-reported evidence.
- Clearly separate author claims, our inferences, and limitations; do not imply reproduced results.
- Prefer primary sources and identify inspection depth; include simple Markdown, transcript, or full-history baselines whenever the source provides them.
- Produce documentation only: no implementation, installation, code execution, benchmark reproduction, or infrastructure changes during the first seven days.
- Keep all work in this loop’s branch and link the resulting note to the manager record.

Worker status: orchestrator — completed. No planner or researcher result is recorded yet. The prior manager cycle was closed with unresolved audit gaps, especially missing query outcomes, unverified stopping-rule compliance, and imprecise section records for two sources. Treat those as requirements for this loop, not as findings.
